column6: R. Stull (UBC), Practical Meteorology: An Algebra-based Survey of Atmospheric Science, v1.02b, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Thermodynamics, stability, humidity, clouds, precipitation, forces and winds, fronts, cyclones, foehn.
Waldron & Snyder (U Alberta / Acadia), Geological Structures: a Practical Introduction, CC BY-NC. Orientation, stereonets, folds, strain, fabrics, faults, plus map/cross-section/three-point labs.
S. Earle (BCcampus), Physical Geology 2nd ed., CC BY 4.0. Minerals, igneous/sedimentary/metamorphic rocks, plate tectonics, earthquakes, geological time, glaciation.
D. Perkins (U North Dakota), Mineralogy (OpenGeology), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Crystal symmetry, crystallography, optical mineralogy, mineral groups.
E. Hoek, Practical Rock Engineering (Rocscience, free). Hoek-Brown, GSI, rock-mass classification, in-situ stress, tunnels, spalling, slope stability, kinematics.
A. Verruijt, Soil Mechanics (TU Delft screen book, mirrored by Brno UT course BFA002). Effective stress, consolidation, shear strength, foundations, slopes.

University of Basel (R. Heilbronner et al.) lecture slides: Geologie der Schweiz 2015 (Jura, Rheingraben, Molasse, Helvetikum, Penninikum, Ostalpin, Suedalpin), Strukturgeologie 2016 incl. exam with solutions, deformation mechanisms, field course.
University of Washington ESS 431 Principles of Glaciology (2018 lectures): mass balance, ice deformation, Glen flow law, sliding, ice sheets, sea ice, permafrost.
